title: Shared definitions for UK Generations Study administrative event years and pseudonymised study id codes

missing_numeric.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_numeric.description: Stands for a numeric value that is absent.

missing_string.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_string.description: Stands for a text value that is absent.

missing_datetime.title: Missing or not recorded
missing_datetime.description: Stands for a date-time that is absent. A date in year 9999 cannot be a real date. It is never shifted at pseudonymisation.
